candy_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the approved style sheet: match this style exactly. Image 2 is the closed candy-box to revise.
Change ONLY the round shape to a clearly EIGHT-SIDED OCTAGONAL lacquered Lunar New Year candy box, including an octagonal fitted lid and straight faceted vertical walls. Keep the wax-red/plum lacquer, thin brass edging, little cream blossoms, ink-blue leaves, central plain brass flower knob, same front three-quarter view and same closed lid. Make the eight straight sides and clipped corners obvious at 40px; the silhouette must NOT be circular or elliptical. Keep the same overall width and height and location, with flat short back and front lid edges and two long diagonally clipped corners each side. Base near 88% of square canvas, centred, transparent background. Contents stay hidden. original design, no logos, no brand names or brand shapes, no characters, no text

App: 時光膠囊 / Time Capsule. People send a sealed letter that can only be opened at a set time and place. Mood: tender, human, nostalgic, "precious in the AI age". Hand-inked storybook, not glossy 3D.
- Clean ink line art with a slightly hand-drawn line, flat colour fills plus one soft shading tone, a little paper grain, light hatching only (it must still read at about 120 px). Lines in plum #6E2B3F or navy #16263F.
- Palette only: ink blue #2F5D8A, light blue #5A8FD0, glass blue #DCE8F2, plum #6E2B3F, brass #C9A15A, wax red #A3364F, navy #16263F, paper #F6F8FB, cream #F3E2BB. Warm brown wood is allowed for wooden objects.
- Front three-quarter view, soft top-left light. No text, letters, numbers, logos or real brands.
- Transparent background, object centred, generous padding (object fills about 70% of the canvas), square.
Match the attached style sheet exactly.
